row_policy: validation rows only; row_ok filter applies to deterministic_miss

slice_definitions.membership_rule: Artifact row is validation, gold row_ok=True, and deterministic top is Purist-wrong.
Validation note contains current/recent/now language plus historical/previous/stale frequency language.
Deterministic top predicts seizure-free/no-event while gold is not seizure-free, or text combines seizure-free language with breakthrough/event language.
Deterministic top predicts no seizure frequency reference while seizure/event discussion is present, or the LLM changes no-reference to unknown.
Gold label or text contains cluster, diary, month-list, calendar, cumulative count, or distributed-count signals.
Text contains q-interval shorthand, every-interval, inter-seizure interval, range, or maximum-burden language.
Deterministic top is Purist-wrong and the candidate-recall proxy does not recall the gold Purist category.
